import numpy as np

# Reasoning / plan:
# - Hammer lies along Y (handle +Y, head -Y). Arm0 grasps the handle slightly toward the head
#   side of the handle middle, so the +Y end of the handle stays free for Arm1.
#   Grasp with fingers closing along X (perpendicular to the handle): [0, 0.707, 0.707, 0].
# - Lift, then rotate the gripper 90 deg about vertical ([0, 1, 0, 0]) so the free handle end
#   points toward +X (toward Arm1). This gives a clear separation along X between the grippers.
# - Carry the hammer to the handover point near the midpoint (x ~ 0.81) at z ~ 0.175.
#   Arm0 holds at x = 0.76, Arm1 grasps the handle at x = 0.85 (9 cm buffer, still on the
#   handle even for the shortest handle: >= 0.105 m of handle free beyond Arm0's grasp).
# - Arm1 uses gripper facing down opening along Y ([0, 0, 1, 0]), fingers closing across
#   the (now X-aligned) handle. Arm1 approaches from above with z_approach, closes, then Arm0
#   releases and retreats upward and back toward its side.

q0_open_x = np.array([0.0, 0.707, 0.707, 0.0])   # arm0 down, fingers close along X
q0_open_y = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0])       # arm0 down, fingers close along Y
q1_open_y = np.array([0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0])       # arm1 down, fingers close along Y

# --- Move Arm1 to a safe staging pose, well away from the handover zone ---
open_gripper_arm1()
goto_pose_arm1(np.array([1.00, 0.0, 0.40]), q1_open_y)

# --- Arm0: grasp the hammer handle ---
open_gripper_arm0()
hp, _ = get_hammer_pose()
grasp_pos = np.array([hp[0], hp[1] - 0.03, hp[2]])   # a bit toward the head, leaving +Y handle free
goto_pose_arm0(grasp_pos, q0_open_x, z_approach=0.15)
close_gripper_arm0()

# --- Lift straight up ---
z_lift = hp[2] + 0.25
lift_pos = np.array([grasp_pos[0], grasp_pos[1], z_lift])
goto_pose_arm0(lift_pos, q0_open_x)

# --- Rotate in place (pure rotation) so the free handle end points toward +X ---
goto_pose_arm0(lift_pos, q0_open_y)

# --- Translate to above the handover point, then lower to handover height ---
handover_z = 0.175                      # hammer z must be in [0.15, 0.20]
x_arm0_hold = 0.76
x_arm1_grasp = x_arm0_hold + 0.09       # 9 cm buffer between grippers, still on the handle
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([x_arm0_hold, 0.0, z_lift]), q0_open_y)
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([x_arm0_hold, 0.0, handover_z]), q0_open_y)

# --- Arm1: come in from above and grasp the handle ---
goto_pose_arm1(np.array([x_arm1_grasp, 0.0, z_lift]), q1_open_y)
goto_pose_arm1(np.array([x_arm1_grasp, 0.0, handover_z]), q1_open_y, z_approach=0.12)
close_gripper_arm1()

# --- Arm0 releases and retreats upward, then back toward its own side ---
open_gripper_arm0()
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([x_arm0_hold, 0.0, handover_z + 0.20]), q0_open_y)
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([0.45, 0.0, handover_z + 0.25]), q0_open_y)
